sources.snippet: All DistilRoBERTa V1 is a lightweight text embedding model provided by Sentence-Transformers, based on the DistilRoBERTa architecture. It converts text into high-density vectors for semantic similarity calculation, clustering, and retrieval-augmented generation.

sources.title: All Distilroberta models | The GTM Directory
sources.snippet: all-distilroberta-v1 is a general-purpose sentence embedding model built on the distilroberta-base backbone and trained on over 1 billion sentence pairs from diverse sources including Reddit, MS MARCO, S2ORC, and Stack Exchange. Its standout trait is efficient CPU inference with a small memory footprint, trading some representational capacity against full-sized models like all-mpnet-base-v2 ...
